def max_symmetry(grid):
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    
    # All 8 symmetry operations for D4 group
    results = []
    
    # Original
    results.append([row[:] for row in grid])
    
    # Horizontal flip
    hflip = [[grid[r][cols-1-c] for c in range(cols)] for r in range(rows)]
    results.append(hflip)
    
    # Vertical flip  
    vflip = [[grid[rows-1-r][c] for c in range(cols)] for r in range(rows)]
    results.append(vflip)
    
    # Rotate 90
    rot90 = [[hflip[i][rows-1-c] for c in range(cols)] for i in range(rows)]
    results.append(rot90)
    
    # Rotate 180
    rot180 = [[vflip[rows-1-i][j] for j in range(cols)] for i in range(rows)]
    results.append(rot180)
    
    # Rotate 270
    rot270 = [[rot90[i][c] for c in range(cols)] for i in range(rows)][::-1][:cols:]
    results.append(rot270)
    
    # Diagonal (transpose)
    diag = [[grid[c][r] for c in range(cols)] for r in range(rows)]
    results.append(diag)
    
    # Anti-diagonal
    anti_diag = [[grid[rows-1-c][cols-1-r] for c in range(cols)] for r in range(rows)]
    results.append(anti_diag)
    
    # Combine using max
    final = [[0]*cols for _ in range(rows)]
    for mat in results:
        for i in range(rows):
            for j in range(cols):
                final[i][j] = max(final[i][j], mat[i][j])
    
    return final
